answer: An identity bond decays like a river wearing down stone. Each agent locks a bond that a prism splits into dated tranches: 100 credits at entry, losing 5% per epoch unless renewed by verified work. Forging 50 fake identities costs 5,000 credits, draining 250 per epoch, while an honest agent pays one 100-credit renewal. A lantern on the registry shows each bond's strength, so peers refuse fading identities and honest agents keep full weight.
